about.description: Research networking systems engineer at ESnet (Energy Sciences Network) — Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory — working on scientific data movement, SENSE-SDN orchestration, and AI/ML infrastructure for research computing.
details: I work at the intersection of research networking and high-energy physics data movement: SENSE software-defined networking, Rucio/FTS interoperability, telemetry and observability for multi-site network fleets, and Kubernetes infrastructure for science.

Previously at the San Diego Supercomputer Center (UCSD), where I worked on FPGA and programmable-data-plane acceleration, network monitoring, and ML-infrastructure tooling — including P4 on Xilinx FPGAs, SmartNIC testbeds, and a Prometheus exporter for Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 accelerators.
